title: Ontology bootstrap batch 1: axis/vocabulary proposals + normalisation rules + candidate task pairs
question: What axis set, attribute vocabularies, normalisation rules, and candidate similarity-control task pairs does the pinned local LLM propose?

model.note: amendment to section 3.2 (17 Aug): the 1.5B replaces the 3B while F: disk is tight; pinned revision above

generation.note: greedy decoding; deterministic given the pinned weights

batch1.role: Propose a refined task-descriptor axis set with attribute vocabularies, given the provisional schema. Output STRICT JSON only: {"axes": {"axis.name": ["token", ...]}, "notes": ["..."]}.
batch1.input_includes: the provisional AXES schema from geode.descriptor

batch2.role: Propose normalisation rules for continuous attributes and eight candidate task pairs/quadruples for similarity positive controls (four known-similar, four known-dissimilar) over the measured axes. Output STRICT JSON only: {"rules": [...], "pairs": [...]}.
batch2.input_includes: the measured task list (DomainNet classification, CIFAR-10 classification, Mackey-Glass forecasting, Lorenz-63 forecasting, Dyck grammar, tabular regression)

constraints.local_only: model loads local_files_only=True from the pinned snapshot; no API dependency
constraints.no_data_leaves: no corpus data is ever passed to the model
constraints.proposals_not_truth: outputs are PROPOSALS; ratification is a human step, then frozen as task_ontology_v0.json (I3)
